requirements.text: Accept two or more JSON object filenames and emit their left-to-right recursive merge as one compact JSON line.
Recursively merge object values, while later arrays and scalar values replace earlier values entirely.
For too few files, invalid JSON, or a non-object root, exit 2 with an error on stderr and no traceback.

regressions.text: Sort output object keys for deterministic output regardless of input key order.
